nodes.description: Address of the current contract owner; guards privileged functions via the onlyOwner modifier.
Pending owner set by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership (two-step ownership handover).
Public token symbol string, set to 'FINU' in the constructor.
Public token name string, set to 'FusionInu' in the constructor.
Public token decimals, set to 18 in the constructor.
Total token supply written once in the constructor and read by totalSupply().
Mapping(address => uint) of token balances; mutated by transfer and transferFrom.
Nested allowance mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) mutated by approve/approveAndCall and consumed by transferFrom.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, balance debits and allowance keys.
Checked addition helper (c = a + b; require(c >= a)).
Checked subtraction helper (require(b <= a); c = a - b).
Checked multiplication helper (require(a == 0 || c / a == b)).
Checked division helper (require(b > 0); c = a / b).
Constructor of Owned: assigns owner = msg.sender with no zero-address check.
onlyOwner function that stores a pending newOwner.
Completes ownership transfer; requires msg.sender == newOwner, emits OwnershipTransferred, clears newOwner.
Constructor: sets metadata, total supply and pre-mints the whole supply to a hardcoded address.
Returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] using raw unchecked subtraction instead of SafeMath.
Returns balances[tokenOwner] with no zero-address handling.
Moves tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd on balances.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens without any race-condition mitigation.
Spends allowance allowed[from][msg.sender] and moves tokens from 'from' to 'to'.
Returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets allowance then invokes receiveApproval on the arbitrary spender contract before returning.
Payable fallback that unconditionally reverts, rejecting plain ETH transfers.
onlyOwner sweep that performs an external ERC20 transfer of arbitrary tokens to owner.
Arbitrary external call to a caller-supplied token contract (tokenAddress.transfer(owner, tokens)) executed on behalf of the owner.
Arbitrary external call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) returning control to an untrusted contract.
Raw uint subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] that can underflow (Solidity 0.4.x wraps without revert).
Address whose balance is looked up.
Recipient address of the transfer.
Amount of tokens to move.
Address granted the allowance.
Allowance amount granted.
Address debited in transferFrom.
Address credited in transferFrom.
Amount moved in transferFrom.
Owner key of the allowance query.
Spender key of the allowance query.
Untrusted contract that will be called back via receiveApproval.
Allowance amount granted before the external call.
Arbitrary calldata forwarded to the untrusted spender contract.
Caller-supplied (owner-supplied) token contract address to be called.
Amount of foreign tokens to sweep to owner.
Candidate address proposed as the next owner.

edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, so the deployer controls all onlyOwner paths.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender with owner before allowing transferOwnership.
transferOwnership writes the caller-supplied _newOwner into newOwner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before completing the handover.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into owner, changing privileged control.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0) after the handover.
Constructor assigns the fixed total supply value to _totalSupply.
Constructor pre-mints the entire supply into balances of a hardcoded address.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply and subtracts balances[address(0)] without SafeMath.
balances[address(0)] feeds an unchecked subtraction in totalSupply, enabling underflow.
The unchecked subtraction performed inside totalSupply is the unsafe arithmetic operation.
balanceOf returns balances[tokenOwner] directly from storage.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping for sender and recipient.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender], letting the caller choose which account is charged.
transferFrom credits balances[to] and debits balances[from].
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender], so the allowance check is caller-scoped.
The spender identity used as the allowance key comes directly from msg.sender.
approve overwrites allowed[msg.sender][spender] with no protection against the allowance race.
approve keys the allowance on msg.sender, so the caller controls the owner slot being written.
allowance returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender] from storage.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before making the external call.
approveAndCall uses msg.sender as the allowance owner key while calling an arbitrary spender.
approveAndCall pushes state into the untrusted spender via receiveApproval call data.
The untrusted spender contract regains control during receiveApproval and can re-enter approveAndCall/transferFrom before returning.
transferAnyERC20Token is gated by the onlyOwner modifier reading owner.
Owner-supplied tokenAddress and tokens flow into an arbitrary external ERC20 transfer call.
The arbitrary token contract re-enters control while the sweep call is in flight, before transferAnyERC20Token returns.
transfer delegates balance debits to safeSub for checked subtraction.
transfer delegates balance credits to safeAdd for checked addition.
transferFrom uses safeSub for both the balance and the allowance decrement.
transferFrom uses safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
tokenOwner indexes the balances mapping inside balanceOf.
The 'to' argument is the recipient key written in transfer.
The tokens argument determines the amount debited/credited in transfer.
spender is the inner allowance key set by approve.
tokens is the allowance value stored by approve.
from is the balance key debited by transferFrom.
to is the balance key credited by transferFrom.
tokens is the amount moved by transferFrom.
tokenOwner is the outer allowance key queried by allowance.
spender is the inner allowance key queried by allowance.
spender is both the allowance key and the untrusted contract address called by approveAndCall.
tokens is written into the allowance before the external call.
data is forwarded verbatim into the untrusted receiveApproval call.
tokenAddress becomes the target contract of the external sweep call.
tokens is the amount passed to the foreign token transfer.
_newOwner is stored as the pending owner by transferOwnership.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter only indexes the balances mapping inside balanceOf; it should be folded into the function node.
Recipient parameter is a pure local of transfer and is merged into the function node.
Amount parameter only parameterizes the safeAdd/safeSub calls inside transfer.
Allowance key parameter has no independent semantic role outside approve.
Allowance value parameter is only used to write allowed inside approve.
Debit address parameter is only consumed by the balances/allowed writes in transferFrom.
Credit address parameter is only consumed by the balances write in transferFrom.
Amount parameter only parameterizes the checked arithmetic inside transferFrom.
Outer mapping key parameter has no meaning outside the allowance getter.
Inner mapping key parameter has no meaning outside the allowance getter.
Spender parameter is the untrusted callee and must be tracked with the approveAndCall/external-call operation.
Allowance amount parameter only feeds the approval write preceding the external call.
Raw calldata parameter is forwarded directly into the untrusted external call, so it is normalized into that unsafe operation.
Arbitrary target address drives the owner-privileged external call and is normalized into that unsafe operation.
Amount parameter only parameterizes the external sweep call to the untrusted token contract.
Candidate owner parameter is only stored by transferOwnership and has no standalone semantics.
